notes.notes:
It made it possible to move operation with the keyboard.
You can move with the cursor keys.

----- Additions : Keyboad Operation -----------------------------------------
<<Normal movement>>
<Cursor keys>
Up
down
left
right
Up + left
Up + right
down + left
down + right

<<Ladder movement>>
<Cursor keys>
Up
down

<<Operation of drone>>
<Cursor keys>
left + right = Level flight(!important!)
left
right
(Up = Level flight)

<<Item acquisition>>
A = Erase window
